> **Platform**: Android

# ZodiakLabel ✅ Ported

```kotlin
@Composable
fun ZodiakLabel(
    text: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    color: Color = Color.Unspecified,
)
```

Style: `MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium` (12sp Medium)
iOS equivalent: `ZodiakText(style: .body(bold: true))` for labels

**When to use:** Form field labels, compact metadata with emphasis.
